normalized_documents.description: One entry per Wave 1 input document. Nodes enriched with normalization fields.

client_entity.description: Legal name of the target entity (Layer 0)

source_document.description: GCS path or document name this graph was extracted from

nodes.description: All ownership nodes from Wave 1, each enriched with normalization fields

conflicts.description: Conflicts carried forward unchanged from Wave 1

parent_id.description: Original Wave 1 parent slug id. Unchanged.

name.description: Legal name exactly as extracted in Wave 1. Never modified.

normalizedName.description: Canonical name after normalization. For entities: most complete legal form with standardized suffix. For Natural Persons: full name in Title Case (without honorific).

dedupKey.description: For entities: lowercase slug of normalized name with legal suffix stripped, spaces replaced by underscores. E.g. 'Deutsche Bank AG' → 'deutsche_bank'. For Natural Persons: lowercase(firstName)|lowercase(lastName). Mononyms: |lowercase(lastName).

asciiDedupKey.description: ASCII-only version of dedupKey. German umlauts use digraphs: ü→ue, ö→oe, ä→ae. ß→ss. All other diacritics strip to base character. Must contain only ASCII characters.

normalizationNote.description: Audit notes: suffix standardizations, script conversions, OCR healing, alias detections. null if no notable transformations.

firstName.description: Natural Person only. Given name in Title Case. null for mononyms. null for all non-person node types.

middleName.description: Natural Person only. Middle name in Title Case. null if absent or non-person.

lastName.description: Natural Person only. Family name in Title Case, including compound surnames and particles. For mononyms, the single name. null for non-person node types.

personalTitle.description: Natural Person only. Honorific stripped from name (Dr., Prof., Herr, etc.). null if none or non-person.
